name: Provider Conformance Matrix
description: Maintain a matrix of provider conformance: which features each provider supports and at what quality level. Tracks conformance for: tool calling, structured output, streaming, vision/image input, audio input, parallel tool calls, system prompt length, context window advertized vs achieved, and reliability metrics. Updated by integration test runs.
purpose: Give routing and capability layers a ground-truth view of what providers actually support (vs what they claim), enabling reliable feature-aware routing decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: Matrix is a structured record mapping provider+model to feature conformance levels
Conformance levels: full, partial, broken, untested
Features tracked: toolCalling, structuredOutput, streaming, visionInput, audioInput, parallelToolCalls, systemPrompt, contextWindow, functionCalling
Quality metrics: success rate (last 100 runs), average latency, average cost per request
Matrix can be updated programmatically by integration tests
Matrix includes metadata: lastTestedAt, testVersion, notes
Conformance data is queryable by the Router for feature-aware routing
Matrix entries can be manually overridden with notes and overriddenBy field
